name: Wilson County, TN
findings: Wilson County has 391 nonprofit organizations. 137 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 109 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Wilson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Wilson County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 117 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Wilson County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 67 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 32 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few professional organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 professional organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through professional groups? Where else does that happen?
